directive.quote: finish the trillion-launch-video port so the repo can be retired

targets.baseline_commit_message: measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging: the character-cast scripts of trillion-launch-video, byte for byte

preserve: a format per video: short, series by title start, compilation, members-only without views, side by pattern or under 3 minutes, else episode
the baseline is the median views of the 10 nearest same-format videos on each side
an info.json gives the exact date, else the timestamp day with ~
allowed_deltas: the series prefixes, compilation words and side pattern are the person's settings
the library folder and channel name come in the request
banned_substitutions: a format list in the code

required_mechanisms: nb = [x['views'] for j, x in enumerate(seq) if j != i and abs(j - i) <= 10 and x['views']]

_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash) and by line ranges: the lines left out held a show, a character or a person by name, a video id or a private path, and became the person's settings or the request's folders.
